name: voice-input
description: Accessible Control Center, compact voice sidebar, opt-in Soniox transcription, editable commands, and OS-dependent system speech.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Voice transcription and mapping management remain available, but custom VS Code command and language-model tool execution is blocked until the workspace is trusted.

languageModelTools.name: voice-input_listMappings
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Lists one deterministic page of the opaque IDs, user labels, and descriptions of enabled Voice Input mappings that the user explicitly made available to Agent Mode. Follow nextCursor until null to list all mappings. Static command arguments and tool input are never returned.

cursor.description: Zero-based cursor returned as nextCursor by the previous page. Omit for the first page.

limit.description: Maximum mappings to return in this page.

languageModelTools.name: voice-input_runMapping
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Runs one enabled, Agent-exposed Voice Input mapping by its opaque mapping ID after VS Code asks the user to confirm the exact saved target. The model cannot provide a command ID, tool name, or arguments.

mappingId.description: Opaque mapping ID returned by voice-input_listMappings.

voiceInput.languageHint.description: Soniox language hint (ISO code, e.g. he, en, ar, fa). 'auto' disables language_hints. Full list visible in the sidebar dropdown.

voiceInput.audioDevice.description: Audio input device identifier managed by 'Voice Input: Select Audio Device' in the Command Palette or sidebar. Empty uses the system default.

voiceInput.assistantWakePhrase.description: Optional assistant wake phrase. Empty uses the built-in Hebrew and English wake phrases.

voiceInput.assistantResumeOnStartup.description: Resume assistant listening after extension startup only when consent, credentials, microphone readiness, and workspace trust are already available. Startup resume never opens setup prompts or connection tests.

voiceInput.assistantPersona.description: Legacy built-in persona selection retained for agent migration. Manage the active agent and provider in the Voice Input Settings view.

enumDescriptions: Disable remote smart planning. Deterministic commands remain available.
Allow DeepSeek smart planning only when a credential and explicit consent are also present.
voiceInput.assistantIntelligence.description: Legacy off/DeepSeek compatibility setting retained for migration. Use Assistant Provider and Provider Profiles for current provider selection.

voiceInput.deepSeekModel.description: Legacy DeepSeek model setting retained for one-time migration.

voiceInput.assistantProvider.description: Optional planning provider. Selecting a provider never sends data or starts a connection test by itself.

voiceInput.providerProfiles.description: Non-secret provider endpoints, models, and enabled state. API keys and tokens are stored only in VS Code SecretStorage and must never be entered here.

endpoint.description: HTTPS planning endpoint. Ollama alone may use HTTP on a loopback hostname.

voiceInput.assistantSpeechEnabled.description: Allow the assistant to speak feedback using a voice installed on the system.

voiceInput.assistantSpeechVoiceUri.description: Voice URI selected from the operating system voices shown in the sidebar.

enumDescriptions: Use Soniox only after a key and machine-local remote-processing consent are present.
An upgrade is awaiting local-only resolution of the previous Soniox credential.
voiceInput.transcriptionProvider.description: Speech-to-text provider selection. Selection alone never starts a network request.

voiceInput.autoMode.description: Display/request state only. Effective Auto Mode requires a machine-local receipt created by an explicit native confirmation.

voiceInput.historyTtlDays.description: Days to keep transcription history. 0 = forever.

voiceInput.injectionMode.description: auto: text-file tab → editor cursor; otherwise clipboard + the platform paste helper. paste-key preserves Unicode/RTL through the clipboard. type-key uses the platform typing helper and may depend on keyboard layout. editor-only / clipboard-only are restricted fallbacks.
